title: EventConsoleEvent
description: An event on the event-console topic. The content model is CLOSED (additionalProperties: false): an event may carry only the properties declared here. That makes a misspelt field a rejected event instead of silently lost data, and it is what lets the registry's BACKWARD rule allow a later version to add an OPTIONAL property (in an open model, adding one is not backward-compatible, because old data could already carry a property of that name with any type).
